style: Painterly realism in the tradition of classic 1990s science-fiction paperback and poster illustration: rich saturated color, dramatic cinematic rim lighting, heroic composition, confident visible brushwork, atmospheric depth, clean hard-surface design for vehicles and ships, and a bold silhouette that still reads when reduced to 72x72 pixels.
rules: Fully original artwork. Do not copy or closely imitate any existing illustration, film still, poster, book cover, game asset, or toy.
Faces are original and must not resemble any real actor or person.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, insignia, emblems, symbols, watermarks, or borders anywhere in the image.
Transparent background; no ground shadow; the whole subject visible with an empty margin.
Equipment, clothing, colors, and proportions must match the description exactly; the same design is reused for every animation frame.

units.sw_hero_luke: A young man in his late twenties with short sandy-blond hair and blue eyes, wearing a plain black tunic and trousers with black boots and a simple dark utility belt; he holds an ignited green energy blade in a two-handed ready stance. Calm, focused expression.
units.sw_hero_xwing_luke: A sleek four-winged starfighter seen from three-quarter view with wings spread in an X, white-gray hull with muted red stripes, a long nose, four wingtip laser cannons, and a small domed droid socket behind the cockpit.
units.sw_hero_leia: A woman in her early thirties with long dark-brown hair braided and coiled at the back of her head, wearing a practical white jumpsuit with a gray utility belt and a small blaster pistol; determined, composed expression.
units.sw_hero_han: A rugged man in his late thirties with tousled brown hair, a lopsided half-smile, a cream-white shirt under an open black vest, dark-blue trousers with a red stripe down the outer seam, tall black boots, and a heavy blaster pistol in a low-slung holster on a gunbelt.
units.sw_hero_chewbacca: A towering humanoid covered in long shaggy brown fur, with a bandolier of small metal pouches crossing his chest and a heavy crossbow-like energy bowcaster; blue eyes, fierce but loyal bearing.
units.sw_hero_lando: A suave man in his late thirties with dark skin, short black hair, and a neat thin mustache, wearing a sky-blue shirt, dark trousers, boots, and a short blue cape lined with gold, holding a compact blaster pistol.
units.sw_hero_mara: A lithe woman in her late twenties with long red-gold hair and green eyes, wearing a close-fitting black jumpsuit and boots, with a small hold-out blaster and a slim vibroblade; cool, dangerous expression.
units.sw_hero_karrde: A slim, intelligent-looking man in his forties with short dark hair and a neat beard, wearing a practical tan spacer's jacket over a dark shirt, carrying a blaster pistol; a calm, appraising expression.
units.sw_hero_wedge: A compact white-gray four-winged starfighter with wings spread in an X and orange-gold stripes, a long nose and four wingtip laser cannons, flown by a veteran ace.
units.sw_hero_pellaeon: A distinguished man in his sixties with white hair and a neat white mustache, wearing an olive-gray naval officer's tunic with a small rank plaque on the chest, dark trousers, and black boots, holding a sidearm.
units.sw_hero_thrawn: A tall, composed alien man with blue skin, glowing red eyes, and neat blue-black hair, wearing an immaculate white naval admiral's uniform with gold shoulder boards and a small rank plaque, hands clasped behind his back.
units.sw_unit_nr_trooper: A New Republic infantry soldier in olive-drab fatigues, a padded gray blast vest, an open-faced helmet with visor, and a compact energy rifle.
units.sw_unit_nr_sergeant: A veteran New Republic infantry sergeant in olive-drab fatigues with a padded gray blast vest and an open-faced helmet, holding an energy rifle and gesturing forward.
units.sw_unit_nr_commando: A lightly equipped commando in dark-green camouflage fatigues and a soft cap, carrying a short energy carbine and a combat knife.
units.sw_unit_nr_eweb_team: A soldier in olive fatigues and blast vest crouched behind a heavy tripod-mounted repeating energy cannon with a power generator cable.
units.sw_unit_nr_field_medic: A field medic in olive fatigues with a white vest marked only by red stripes, carrying a medical satchel and a small blaster pistol.
units.sw_unit_nr_militia: A local planetary militia volunteer in patched civilian work clothes and an armored vest, holding an older blaster pistol.
units.sw_unit_wk_warrior: A Wookiee: a towering, shaggy, ape-like forest warrior covered head to foot in long brown and gray fur, with a flat primate face, deep-set eyes and a short muzzle (not canine, not wolf-like, no pointed ears or snout), wearing a leather baldric and wielding a curved broad wooden-hilted blade.
units.sw_unit_wk_lookout: A Wookiee: a tall, lean, shaggy, ape-like forest scout covered in long light-brown fur, with a flat primate face (not canine, no snout), a leather shoulder strap, and a crossbow-like energy bowcaster.
units.sw_unit_nr_xwing: A four-winged white-gray starfighter with wings spread in an X, red stripes, a long nose, and four wingtip laser cannons.
units.sw_unit_nr_awing: A small, very fast wedge-shaped interceptor starfighter, white with red markings, two large engines at the rear and swivel cannons on the wingtips.
units.sw_unit_nr_ywing: A long, rugged bomber starfighter with a forward cockpit pod, an exposed frame, two long engine nacelles, and yellow markings on gray paneling.
units.sw_unit_nr_docked_warship: A medium-sized white frigate warship with a long hull, a rear engine block, and docking clamps attached.
units.sw_unit_im_stormtrooper: An Imperial soldier in full white plastoid armor with black undersuit, a fully enclosed white helmet with dark eye lenses, and a black blaster rifle.
units.sw_unit_im_stormtrooper_sergeant: An Imperial squad leader in full white plastoid armor with an orange shoulder pauldron, a fully enclosed white helmet with dark lenses, and a black blaster rifle.
units.sw_unit_im_scout_trooper: A lightly armored Imperial scout in a white helmet with a long visor, black fatigues and white chest plate, riding a narrow repulsorlift speeder bike with forward control vanes.
units.sw_unit_im_officer: An Imperial field officer in an olive-gray tunic with a small rank plaque, a soft billed cap, black gloves, and a holstered sidearm.
units.sw_unit_im_at_st: A two-legged armored scout walker with a boxy angular gray cockpit head, chin-mounted twin blaster cannons, and thin jointed legs.
units.sw_unit_im_noghri: A short, wiry gray-skinned alien commando with a heavy protruding jaw, dark eyes, and a sleek dark combat suit, holding curved knives in a low crouch.
units.sw_unit_im_tie_fighter: A small starfighter with a spherical cockpit with a round front window, flanked by two flat hexagonal solar-panel wings on short pylons, dark gray.
units.sw_unit_im_tie_interceptor: A small starfighter with a spherical cockpit and two dagger-shaped, bent-wing solar panels with wingtip cannons, dark gray.
units.sw_unit_im_tie_bomber: A double-hulled starfighter with a ball cockpit beside an elongated ordnance pod, flanked by two bent solar-panel wings, dark gray.
units.sw_unit_im_mole_miner: A squat industrial mining craft with an ochre-yellow rounded hull, heavy armor plates, and forward plasma cutting jets.
units.sw_unit_im_star_destroyer: A huge dagger-shaped gray capital warship seen from three-quarter view, with a stepped command tower near the stern and rows of turbolaser turrets.
units.sw_unit_sm_smuggler: A fringe smuggler in a worn tan jacket over a dark shirt, cargo trousers, boots, and a blaster pistol at the hip.
units.sw_unit_sm_veteran: A hardened bald human smuggler, full body from head to boots, with a scarred face, a gray flight jacket and leather vest, holding a long blaster rifle. A single standing character, never an icon, emblem or abstract shape.
units.sw_unit_wl_vornskr: A lean, wolf-sized four-legged predator with smooth gray hide, a long whip-like tail, a narrow toothed snout, and pale eyes.
units.sw_hero_khabarakh: A short, wiry gray-skinned alien commando with a heavy protruding jaw and dark eyes, wearing a sleek dark combat suit with a small clan sash, holding curved knives; an alert, uncertain expression.
units.sw_hero_cbaoth: A tall, gaunt old man with a very long flowing white beard and long white hair, wearing simple brown robes over a cream tunic, holding an ignited green energy blade; piercing, imperious eyes.
units.sw_hero_bel_iblis: A distinguished, fit man in his sixties with swept-back silver hair, wearing a dark olive military greatcoat with brass buttons over a field uniform, holding a blaster pistol; calm, commanding expression.
units.sw_unit_bi_commando: An elite private-army infantry soldier in khaki-brown fatigues with tan armored plates and a full-coverage helmet with a dark visor, holding a blaster rifle.
units.sw_unit_im_clone_trooper: An Imperial soldier in full white plastoid armor with a black undersuit and a fully enclosed white helmet with dark eye lenses, holding a black blaster rifle, standing rigidly at the ready.
units.sw_unit_im_decon_droid: A bulky, slow industrial droid on short tracked legs with a dented ochre hull, a chemical sprayer nozzle, and a heavy manipulator arm.
units.sw_unit_ob_dreadnaught: A long, old-fashioned heavy cruiser warship, weathered gray-tan hull with ribbed sections, a blocky command bridge, and banks of turbolaser turrets.
units.sw_unit_nr_boarding_shuttle: A boxy armored assault shuttle with stubby wings, white and blue paneling, and a heavy forward docking hatch.
units.sw_unit_im_boarding_shuttle: An angular gray Imperial assault shuttle with folded wings, a heavy forward boarding hatch, and twin laser cannons.
units.sw_hero_luuke: A young man in his early twenties with dark hair, a pale face, and cold, empty eyes, wearing a plain black tunic and trousers, holding an ignited green energy blade in an aggressive stance.
units.sw_unit_wy_myneyrshi: A lean alien native with four arms and dark leathery skin, wearing a woven loincloth, beads, and feathers, holding a long spear in two hands and a short bow in the other two.
units.sw_unit_wy_psadan: A short, stocky alien native whose body is covered in overlapping gray stone-like armor plates, carrying a heavy wooden war club.
units.sw_unit_im_royal_guard: An elite guard in flowing crimson robes and a smooth crimson full helmet with a narrow black visor slit, holding a tall force pike.
units.sw_unit_im_infiltrator: A commando in a matte black infiltration suit with a close-fitting helmet and green-tinted goggles, holding a combat knife and a small blaster pistol.
units.sw_unit_im_minelayer: A converted bulk freighter: a long boxy gray hull with open release bays along its belly and small Imperial gun turrets.
units.sw_unit_ob_cloaked_asteroid: A rough gray-brown asteroid shimmering faintly at its edges with a half-visible stealth field.
units.sw_unit_ob_shield_generator: A squat armored planetary shield generator: a gray dome on a fortified base with glowing blue emitter vanes.
units.sw_unit_ob_cloning_cylinder: A tall glass cloning cylinder filled with pale green fluid and a vague human shape, on a metal base with cables and pipes.
units.sw_unit_ob_shipyard_platform: A large orbital shipyard platform: a skeletal gray framework with work lights, cranes, and a half-built hull inside.

portrait_policy: Characters portrayed by film actors use a portrait framed from their sprite, not a close-up face, so no real person's likeness is shown.
